name: HotpotQA
intro: HotpotQA 是多跳问答 benchmark，报告中常与 NaturalQuestions 等检索问答任务一起用于评估长链路推理。
build_method: Wikipedia超链接图采样, 众包多跳出题, 模型辅助难度划分
metric: 答案EM/F1, 支持事实EM/F1, 联合EM/F1
task_type: 多跳问答, 阅读理解
build_method_en: Wikipedia hyperlink-graph sampling, crowdsourced multi-hop questions, model-assisted hardness splits
intro_en: HotpotQA is a multi-hop QA benchmark often reported alongside NaturalQuestions-style retrieval QA tasks for evaluating chained reasoning.
metric_en: Answer EM/F1, Supporting-fact EM/F1, Joint EM/F1
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1809.09600 Sections 2, 3, and 5. HotpotQA builds a graph from first-paragraph Wikipedia links, then samples bridge pairs 75% of the time and comparison pairs from 42 entity lists otherwise. Crowdworkers write answers and sentence-level supporting facts. From 112,779 valid examples, Turker audits isolate 18,089 mostly single-hop train-easy items, three-fold model filtering yields 56,814 train-medium items, and remaining hard items form train-hard, Dev, and separate distractor/full-wiki tests. Evaluation reports answer, supporting-fact, and joint EM/F1.
